name: Suspension Face Pull
steps: Face a suspension trainer anchor, grip both handles with palms facing down, and lean back with straight arms and a braced trunk.
Pull your body upward by driving your elbows high and wide while drawing the handles beside your forehead.
Rotate your forearms backward at the top so your thumbs point behind you and squeeze your upper back.
Lower yourself smoothly back to straight arms while maintaining a straight plank line.
tips: Keep your elbows at shoulder height throughout the pull rather than dropping them toward your ribs.
Avoid jutting your chin forward or letting your hips sag as you pull.
